narrative.overview: The implemented direction is restrained modern consumer discovery: a white/light identity, Duke-inspired blue accents, readable Manrope typography, useful photography, and clear interactions. It serves students browsing on phones between campus activities. Blue creates emphasis and selected states; white surfaces keep resource names, reviews, and comparison data prominent.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces, a near-white canvas, and restrained blue accents.
Compact discovery content and honest entity imagery.
Shared controls, clear route states, and mobile bottom navigation.
Generic components driven by school, category, entity, and dimension data.

rules.name: The Light Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep the existing `color-scheme: light`; the current system has no implemented dark theme.

dos: Do reuse the shared Manrope, Button, Navigation, SearchField, EmptyState, and card components.
Do preserve school scope, configuration-driven labels, existing galleries, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do inspect mobile and desktop output after changing the stylesheet cascade.
Do keep demo preview evidence separate from live Supabase verification.
donts: Don't hardcode campus entities, categories, or rating dimensions into page components.
Don't replace the white/light identity with a dark theme or add generated imagery to this refresh.
Don't change backend behavior, identity redaction, permissions, or gallery seed data as a visual styling shortcut.
Don't remove legacy styles wholesale; migrate and verify feature layouts incrementally.
